title: People Over 65 Now Outnumber Young Children
hook: 705 million older people now outnumber the youngest children.
closing: An older world will reshape work, healthcare, and family care.
question: How will aging change your family?

segments.say: People over 65 reached 705 million. For the first time, they outnumbered children under five.
The older population is projected to reach 1.6 billion. The first crossover is only the beginning.
By 2050, older people will more than double the youngest children. The world's age balance keeps tilting.
